checkpoints.name: Figurine Gallery opens
checkpoints.detail: After Deepwood Shrine, once the Earth Element makes the White Sword

checkpoints.name: Cave of Flames
checkpoints.detail: Clear the Cave of Flames (Fire Element)

checkpoints.name: Vaati takes the king
checkpoints.detail: Vaati possesses King Daltus, on the first trip to the Western Wood

checkpoints.name: Fortress of Winds
checkpoints.detail: Clear the Fortress of Winds (Ocarina of Wind)

checkpoints.name: Big Blue Chuchu
checkpoints.detail: Defeat the Big Blue Chuchu in the Temple of Droplets (Flame Lantern)

checkpoints.name: Temple of Droplets
checkpoints.detail: Clear the Temple of Droplets (Water Element)

checkpoints.name: Royal Crypt
checkpoints.detail: Speak to King Gustaf at the end of the Royal Crypt

checkpoints.name: Palace of Winds reached
checkpoints.detail: Reach the Palace of Winds (Ezlo's talk at its entrance)

checkpoints.name: Palace of Winds
checkpoints.detail: Clear the Palace of Winds (Wind Element)

checkpoints.name: Final series
checkpoints.detail: Defeat Vaati and watch the credits

figurines.name: Capless Link
figurines.description: A young boy who lives in Hyrule. He is close friends with Princess Zelda.

figurines.name: Ezlo and Link
figurines.description: A young boy on a quest with Ezlo to restore the Four Sword. With the sword's power, he hopes to remove the curse on Princess Zelda.

figurines.name: Princess Zelda
figurines.description: A bright and cheery princess from Hyrule's royal family. She loves to sneak out of the castle to visit her good friend, Link.

figurines.name: Ezlo (Cap)
figurines.description: A strange creature that looks at first like a cap. He speaks roughly and treats Link like a child, but he actually really likes Link.

figurines.name: Sorcerer Vaati
figurines.description: When the young Minish donned Ezlo's magic cap, he took this evil form. Now, he searches for the light force in his quest to become all-powerful.

figurines.name: King Daltus
figurines.description: The king of Hyrule. Reported to have been a fine swordsman, he appeared in the Picori Festival tournament as a youth and fought to a draw with Smith.

figurines.name: Minister Potho
figurines.description: The supporting pillar of Hyrule. He is also in charge of Princess Zelda's education, so when she goes missing, he gets frustrated.

figurines.name: Smith
figurines.description: The finest swordsmith in Hyrule. As a young man, he was a great swordsman. He and King Daltus are friends and enjoyed a pleasant rivalry as youths.

figurines.name: Mayor Hagen
figurines.description: The mayor of the town of Hyrule. He's a big collector of odd masks. He's built a shelter into his garden just in case monsters ever attack Hyrule.

figurines.name: Marcy
figurines.description: Second in command at Hyrule's post office. She's mellow and laid-back, entirely unlike the high-strung and easily excitable Stamp.

figurines.name: Stamp
figurines.description: A busy, hardworking postal employee, although he can be a touch edgy. The stamp he uses is his own personal one, so please don't borrow it. Thanks.

figurines.name: Rem
figurines.description: The proprietor of Rem's Shoe Store. Using his "secret technique," he makes shoes in his sleep. Princess Zelda is his single biggest source of income.

figurines.name: Dr. Left
figurines.description: A gruff-talking academic type who is obsessed with studying the Picori. He doesn't seem to be aware that they are actually living in his own house.

figurines.name: Carlov
figurines.description: A sculptor of finely crafted figurines. Many consider him the best sculptor in all of Hyrule. He enjoys collecting Mysterious Shells.

figurines.name: Borlov
figurines.description: Owner of the Chest Mini-Game Shop. Carlov's younger brother. He detests gambling, but he has made the biggest gamble of all: entrepreneurship.

figurines.name: Stockwell
figurines.description: The handy neighborhood gear seller, also called Stockwell the Well-Stocked. He complains that he's been too busy lately to see his dog, Fifi.

figurines.name: Simon
figurines.description: His mysterious dungeon-simulation game is very popular in Hyrule. It gives players the illusion of fighting real monsters in real dungeons.

figurines.name: Gorman
figurines.description: He wants to rent out his house in town, but he's too overbearing to attract a tenant. He doesn't even seem to realize what the problem is...

figurines.name: Anju
figurines.description: This young woman tends to her cuccos in Hyrule Town. If you help her gather her loose cuccos, she'll give you a reward.

figurines.name: Brocco
figurines.description: Hyrule's vegetable vendor. He sells fine produce. He also argues constantly with the fruit vendor, Pina, over the health benefits of vegetables.

figurines.name: Pina
figurines.description: Hyrule's fruit vendor. She hates vegetables, so she won't even sell tomatoes, even though they technically ARE fruits. Freak.

figurines.name: Beedle
figurines.description: Though he is an adult, he is very good at finding Picolyte made by the Minish. And he is very, VERY convincing about their healthful properties.
figurines.requirement: Suck the dust off the empty stall's carpet in Hyrule Town with the Gust Jar

figurines.name: Postman
figurines.description: A very serious mail deliveryman. He continues to make every delivery right on time every day.

figurines.name: Crenel Hermit
figurines.description: A hermit who lives on Mount Crenel. He has lots of Kinstone pieces. He brags that he won the festival tournament when he was younger.
figurines.requirement: Meet the Crenel Hermit in his cave on Mount Crenel

figurines.name: Monster Lady
figurines.description: A weird old lady living in Percy's house without his permission. She doesn't want you to turn on the lights. She might actually be a...

figurines.name: Dampé
figurines.description: The gravedigger at the cemetery. They say he has the power to speak with the dead. He fuses the Kinstones he digs up with the local ghosts.

figurines.name: Gustaf, Royal Spirit
figurines.description: The spirit of an ancient king of Hyrule who wishes to secure peace in his land from beyond the grave. He was very fond of the people of the Wind Tribe.

figurines.name: Syrup
figurines.description: A wizard who lives in the Minish Woods. She sells magic items with odd powers. She's looking for an apprentice to whom she can teach her mystic spells.

figurines.name: Great Butterfly Fairy
figurines.description: The Great Butterfly Fairy of Minish Woods. She provides you with a larger wallet, allowing you to carry more Rupees with you.

figurines.name: Great Mayfly Fairy
figurines.description: The Great Mayfly Fairy of Mount Crenel. She provides you with a larger bomb bag, allowing you to carry more bombs with you.

figurines.name: Great Dragonfly Fairy
figurines.description: The Great Dragonfly Fairy of Royal Valley. She gives you a larger quiver, allowing you to carry more arrows with you.

figurines.name: Percy
figurines.description: A poet who lives in Western Wood. He comes home from a long journey to find his house occupied by an unwanted guest. Poor guy...

figurines.name: Nayru
figurines.description: She's looking for a house in Hyrule to move into. She is descended from a line of oracles in the land of Labrynna.

figurines.name: Farore
figurines.description: She's looking for a house in Hyrule to move into. She's a very helpful person, but people take advantage of her kind nature. This really bothers her.

figurines.name: Din
figurines.description: She's looking for a house in Hyrule to move into. She is a famous dancer from the land of Holodrum.

figurines.name: Joy Butterfly
figurines.description: A rare butterfly said to bring happiness to those who catch it. If you see one on your journeys, try to grab it!
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones with Din, Nayru or Farore until a Joy Butterfly appears

figurines.name: Gina
figurines.description: A strange Ghini who wants to fuse Kinstone pieces, which is somewhat peculiar for a monster. She has a lot of pieces, so keep on fusing!

figurines.name: Festari
figurines.description: A Minish living in Minish Village. He speaks some human languages. He sees that Link is human with one look. He's a bit of a human enthusiast.

figurines.name: Gentari
figurines.description: The elder of the Forest Minish. He has lived among humans for a long time. He knows where the four elements are. He has a twin brother in Hyrule's library.

figurines.name: Forest Picori
figurines.description: Not visible to the eyes of adults, they delight in making humans happy by hiding helpful items and Rupees under grass and rocks all over the world.

figurines.name: Librari
figurines.description: This Town Minish elder is Gentari's twin brother. Those large wings that he is so proud of are trophies from a duel with a cucco as a young Minish.

figurines.name: Town Picori
figurines.description: These Minish like humans so much that they moved from Minish Village into Hyrule itself! They try to make humans happy, but it sometimes backfires.

figurines.name: Melari
figurines.description: He lives with his seven apprentices in Mount Crenel, which contains all the mineral riches they will ever need. He seems gruff, but he's trustworthy.

figurines.name: Mountain Picori
figurines.description: These seven students followed Melari from Minish Village to Mount Crenel. Their song is actually a sign that they are full-fledged Mountain Minish now.

figurines.name: Goron
figurines.description: These rock- and iron-eaters once lived on Mount Crenel in Western Hyrule. Now their numbers are few, and they live quietly in a cave.
figurines.requirement: Dig out the Goron Cave at Lon Lon Ranch

figurines.name: Minish Vaati
figurines.description: Before he became a sorcerer, he was a simple Minish. He had always been entranced by the evil that lives in the hearts of men...

figurines.name: Vassals
figurines.description: These vassals serve the king of Hyrule. They are loyal and diligent. Like the king himself, they are courteous yet frank.

figurines.name: Library
figurines.description: The Royal Hyrule Library. Although the library is well loved, many forget to return their books, causing no end of trouble for the librarians.

figurines.name: Blade Brothers
figurines.description: All of these self-trained swordsmen have won the fighting tournament at the Picori Festival before. They see great potential in Link.
figurines.pictured: Grayblade, Greatblade, Grimblade, Scarblade, Splitblade, Swiftblade, Swiftblade I, and Waveblade

figurines.name: Wheaton & Pita
figurines.description: This couple bakes bread in Hyrule. Their tasty pastries hold a secret... If you're extra lucky, there'll be a helpful item hidden inside!

figurines.name: Funday School
figurines.description: This is where all the children of Hyrule learn. Link and Princess Zelda studied here, too. The two teachers are twins named Tina and Dina.
figurines.pictured: Berry, Dina, Erik, Harrison, Jim, Joel, Leila, and Tina

figurines.name: Mama's Cafe
figurines.description: This is the best place in town to relax. You can also pick up some good tips, from the latest gossip to observations about the world.
figurines.pictured: Baris, Breve, Chai, Herb, Jasmine, Mama, and an unnamed Hylian

figurines.name: Happy Hearth Inn
figurines.description: This generous inn gives a gift to every guest who stays the night. Guests can unwind in the lobby on the second floor.

figurines.name: Zill and Friends
figurines.description: Zill's the one with the drippy nose. He likes to wander around town with his friends. He knows a lot about Hyrule, and he might even give you some tips!
figurines.pictured: Candy, the Hurdy-Gurdy Man, Lolly, and Zill

figurines.name: The Carpenters
figurines.description: These carpenters may be rough around the edges, but they do good work. They may seem tough, but they're in touch with their feminine side.
figurines.pictured: Bremor, Brent, Doyle, Mack, and Mutoh

figurines.name: Young Couple
figurines.description: Romio and Julietta grew up next door to one another. They're dating now, but they plan to marry once they get their pets' approval.
figurines.pictured: Julietta, Rolf, Romio, Scratcher, and Verona

figurines.name: Peaceful Hyrule 1
figurines.description: Carlov's Peaceful Hyrule Scenery Series No. 1
figurines.pictured: Dottie, Growler, Klaus, Purry, an unnamed Cat, and an unnamed Canine

figurines.name: Peaceful Hyrule 2
figurines.description: Carlov's Peaceful Hyrule Scenery Series No. 2
figurines.pictured: Anton, Gepper, June, Keeley, Marshall, and Sheila

figurines.name: Peaceful Hyrule 3
figurines.description: Carlov's Peaceful Hyrule Scenery Series No. 3
figurines.pictured: Four unnamed Hylians and an unnamed Cat

figurines.name: Cucco!
figurines.description: With a boisterous crow and a cute crest, these feathered friends are the most popular pets in Hyrule. The baby chicks like small bugs.
figurines.pictured: Two Cuccos, three Cucco chicks, and a golden Cucco

figurines.name: At Lon Lon Ranch
figurines.description: This small ranch lies just outside Hyrule Town. Father-and-daughter team Talon and Malon run it, and they sell the finest milk in Hyrule!

figurines.name: The Wind Tribe
figurines.description: The people who built the Wind Ruins. They now live above the clouds, suspended by their own magic ability to control the wind.
figurines.pictured: Caprice, Flurris, Gale, Hailey, Siroc, Strato, and Zeffa

figurines.name: Gregal & the Ghost
figurines.description: An old man plagued by an evil spirit. Coming to his aid will bring you benefit in the end, so if you meet him, you must find a way to help him.

figurines.name: Tingle Siblings?
figurines.description: Tingle (in green) and his twin younger brothers Ankle (in purple) and Knuckle (in blue). They believe fusing Kinstones will help them meet fairies, so they are recording Kinstone data on their maps. David Jr. is not technically a relative.
figurines.pictured: Ankle, David Jr., Knuckle, and Tingle

figurines.name: Eenie & Meenie
figurines.description: The Hyrulean vegetables grown in their fields are exquisitely delicious. Apparently, Brocco sells the best of their crops.

figurines.name: Goron Merchant
figurines.description: This Goron appears when you successfully fuse certain Kinstone pieces. He will sell you expensive, but rare, Kinstone pieces.
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones with the Goron punching the wall

figurines.name: Spookter & Spekter
figurines.description: Ghosts from the Royal Valley. The one in the blue cap is Spookter, and the one in the red cap is Spekter. Spookter tries to be scary, but he's just not.
figurines.pictured: Spekter, Spookter, and an unnamed Hylian
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones with Spookter until Spekter leaves Hyrule Town

figurines.name: Sluggula
figurines.description: Appears in Minish dungeons. They drop from the ceiling unexpectedly. They are slow, so take your time, and defeat them one by one.

figurines.name: Scissors Beetle
figurines.description: Appears in Minish roads & dungeons. These monsters have sharp mandibles. Hit them when they shoot these away. Avoid their attacks to get in close.

figurines.name: Moldworm
figurines.description: Appears in Minish roads. They come out of the ground when they sense prey. If you get swallowed, you'll take damage and get all dirty! Watch out, because when you're all dirty, Pestos will come after you.

figurines.name: Spiked Beetle
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. Covered in hard, spiny shells. Few attacks work on them. You have to flip them over to hurt them.

figurines.name: Eyegore Statue
figurines.description: Appears in Castor Wilds. They move when you put an arrow in their eye. No other attacks work. You can always just let them pass...

figurines.name: Business Scrub
figurines.description: Appears in caves, etc. Normally stay underground. They'll pop out and spit seeds at you, but if you get to know 'em, they're not so bad.

figurines.name: Armos
figurines.description: Appears in the Wind Ruins. Built by the Minish for the Wind Tribe long ago. They look like stone statues, but if you get too close, they move!

figurines.name: Keese
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. These bats live in dungeons and caves. Their movement is unpredictable, so use ranged weapons from a safe distance.

figurines.name: Keaton
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. This thieving fox preys upon travelers and merchants. He may not be strong, but he will attack very quickly, so be careful.
figurines.pictured: A Purple Keaton and a Yellow Keaton

figurines.name: Ghini
figurines.description: Appears in the Royal Valley, etc. These dark beasties are attracted to light, and if they attack you, they may suck your life away!

figurines.name: Gibdo
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds. These mummies keep coming at you when you attack. It's better to fight from a distance if you want to avoid damage.

figurines.name: Rollobite
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. His hard shell protects him from swords, but once he rolls into a ball, you can use the Gust Jar to draw him in.

figurines.name: Spark
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. They cling to walls and move quickly. Normal attacks may not work, but the boomerang is pretty effective.

figurines.name: Dark Nut
figurines.description: Appears in Castor Wilds. These armor-clad soldiers are tough. Use your shield and rolling skills to find an opening in their defenses...

figurines.name: Red Dark Nut
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds. These Dark Nut commanders are strong, but if you relax and wait for your opening, you can still defeat them.

figurines.name: Chaser
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. They move quickly to chase you once they spot you. Your shield will block them, but keep on your toes!

figurines.name: Rock Chuchu
figurines.description: Appears in Veil Falls. These tough Chuchus wear rocks on their heads. The rocks protect them from damage, so you'll have to find a way to knock the rocks off before you'll be able to destroy them.

figurines.name: Moldorm
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. These guys move quickly and randomly. Trap them in a corner and take them out quickly.

figurines.name: Door Mimic
figurines.description: Appears in the Royal Crypt. They look like doors, but they're really traps! If you get too close to one, it will fall down on you!

figurines.name: Peahat
figurines.description: Appears on Mount Crenel, etc. These strange beasts hover on propeller-like leaves. You can pull them out of the sky with your Gust Jar.

figurines.name: Helmasaur
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. Their fronts are protected with metal masks, but their backsides aren't! Pop off that mask for an easy battle.

figurines.name: Wall Master
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. If these guys grab you, they'll send you back to the start of the dungeon. Dodge them as they fall, then attack.

figurines.name: Floor Master
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. If these guys grab you, they'll send you back to the start of the dungeon. Watch out when he attacks with others.

figurines.name: Acro-Bandits
figurines.description: Appears in the Eastern Hills, etc. Five of them pop out at once. If you smack each one as they pop out of the ground, they're a piece of cake.

figurines.name: Bob-omb
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. They often gather in groups in narrow areas. Once activated, they go a little crazy. Take them out with arrows.

figurines.name: Bombarossa
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. They float in the air and explode when touched. Walk carefully, and you may escape unhurt...

figurines.name: Like Like
figurines.description: Appears in caves, dungeons, etc. Don't let them grab you: they'll eat your shield if they hold you long enough. Swing your sword to escape.

figurines.name: Rupee Like
figurines.description: Appears in caves, dungeons, etc. This Rupee Like has a Rupee dangling from its head stalk. This clever lure attracts greedy and delicious heroes.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Rupee Like, a Green Rupee Like, and a Red Rupee Like

figurines.name: Rope
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. They'll come straight for you if they spot you. Just swing your sword when they charge at you.

figurines.name: Boulder
figurines.description: Appears on Mount Crenel, etc. These huge boulders come crashing down from cliff walls. They fall in a random pattern, so watch your step!

figurines.name: Ball & Chain Soldier
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds. They're not fast, but that iron ball is a bruiser! Try to hit them after they swing the ball.

figurines.name: Spiny Beetle
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. They hide under common rocks and grass. Be careful, because they can pop out when you least expect it!

figurines.name: Spear Moblin
figurines.description: Appears in Minish Woods, etc. They rush you on sight. They also block head-on attacks with their spears, so circle around to attack.

figurines.name: Bow Moblin
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. They fire arrows at you on sight. Block these with your shield and then close in to attack.

figurines.name: Cloud Piranha
figurines.description: Appears in the sky. They swim through clouds like fish in water. Attack them in that brief moment when they pop out!

figurines.name: Mulldozer
figurines.description: Appears in Minish roads, dungeons, etc. There are red and blue ones. They may look small and weak, but their hard shells make them formidable.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Mulldozer and a Red Mulldozer

figurines.name: Pesto
figurines.description: Appears in Minish roads, dungeons, etc. There are red and blue ones. The blue ones are stronger and throw things down on your head.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Pesto and a Red Pesto

figurines.name: Puffstool
figurines.description: Appears in Deepwood Shrine. These mushroom beasties scatter spores all over dungeons. When their caps are red, they are invincible.

figurines.name: Wizzrobe
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds, etc. They fire magic bolts from afar. Hit them when they appear so they don't cast another spell!

figurines.name: Fire Wizzrobe
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds. They wield fire magic. Hit them when they appear so they don't cast another spell!

figurines.name: Ice Wizzrobe
figurines.description: Appears in the Palace of Winds. They wield ice magic. They're weak against fire, so attack with fire for a quick battle!

figurines.name: Wisp
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. They float in midair. They won't hurt you, but if you touch them, you won't be able to use your sword for a while.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Wisp and a Red Wisp

figurines.name: Octorok
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. There are red and blue ones. They've appeared in every Zelda game to date. They spit rocks, so be careful!
figurines.pictured: A Red Octorok and a Blue Octorok

figurines.name: Golden Octorok
figurines.description: Appears in... Well, we're not sure! The legendary Golden Octorok. It can't be confirmed, but they are said to shoot chunks of pure gold...
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones to free a Golden Octorok, e.g. with the Business Scrub in Castor Wilds, then the one in the newly opened Minish Woods tree

figurines.name: Golden Tektite
figurines.description: Appears in... Well, we're not sure! The legendary Golden Tektite. Its basic attack is the same, but it has much more power.
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones to free a Golden Tektite, e.g. with the Minish in the south-east room of Melari's Mine

figurines.name: Golden Rope
figurines.description: Appears in... Well, we're not sure! The legendary Golden Rope. It's much more aggressive than the normal ones: it will attack you on sight.
figurines.requirement: Fuse Kinstones to free a Golden Rope, e.g. with Flurris by the stairs on the Wind Tribe tower's third floor

figurines.name: Crow & Takkuri
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. The black one is Crow. If you touch Takkuri, he will steal Rupees from you, so be careful!

figurines.name: Lakitu
figurines.description: Appears in the sky. They float on clouds. They don't move, but they do throw lightning bolts. Steal their clouds with the Gust Jar.

figurines.name: Stalfos
figurines.description: Appears in dungeons. Blue ones jump, and red ones throw bones. See what happens when you remove their heads with the Gust Jar.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Stalfos and a Red Stalfos

figurines.name: Beetle
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. They appear under rocks and grass. If they grab you, you won't be able to move. Swing your sword to get away.

figurines.name: Chuchu
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. Chuchus come in many colors. Each color is a little different, but ranged weapons work well against all.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Chuchu, a Green Chuchu, and a Red Chuchu

figurines.name: Tektite
figurines.description: Appears on Mount Crenel, etc. They move by jumping long distances. Their movement can be unpredictable, so attack them when they are still.
figurines.pictured: A Blue Tektite and a Red Tektite

figurines.name: Trap
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. A trap with sharp blades. Some are triggered by nearby intruders, while others follow a set path.

figurines.name: Leever
figurines.description: Appears in Wind Ruins, Veil Falls. These baddies move freely underground when attacking. You never know where they will pop up, so keep your shield raised and at the ready!
figurines.pictured: A Blue Leever and a red Leever

figurines.name: Madderpillar
figurines.description: Appears in Deepwood Shrine, etc. This caterpillar moves in a zigzag pattern. If you hit him on the nose, he gets upset and starts running around.

figurines.name: Spiny Chuchu
figurines.description: Appears in various areas. These Chuchus project spikes from their bodies at the first sign of danger. Try a well-placed bomb.

figurines.name: Big Octorok
figurines.description: Appears in the Temple of Droplets. Frozen solid by the power of the Water Element. He's been frozen so long that his hunger is unbearable.

figurines.name: Gyorg Pair
figurines.description: Appears in Palace of Winds. Females are larger than males. They fly around the Palace of Winds, preying on adventurers.

figurines.name: Biggoron
figurines.description: This is a legendary Goron with a body bigger than a mountain. This Goron is so big, in fact, that no one has ever seen all of it at once.

figurines.name: Big Green Chuchu
figurines.description: Appears in Deepwood Shrine. A perfectly ordinary Chuchu. Though not much of an enemy usually, they are terrifying to anyone Minish-sized.

figurines.name: Gleerok
figurines.description: Appears in the Cave of Flames. A Gleerok with a hard, rocky shell found in Mount Crenel. Hiding in lava, this beast spews fire on everything it sees.

figurines.name: Mazaal
figurines.description: Appears in the Wind Ruins. Constructed by the Wind Tribe to repel intruders, this sturdy machine cannot be destroyed by any external force.

figurines.name: Big Blue Chuchu
figurines.description: Appears in the Temple of Droplets. An ordinary blue Chuchu. Fighting him while Minish-sized is daunting, but just try to avoid that electric attack.

figurines.name: Zelda & Link
figurines.description: These two became fast friends because of Smith and the king of Hyrule. Zelda wishes that the sometimes unreliable Link were just a wee bit stronger.

figurines.name: Minish Ezlo
figurines.description: The Minish Ezlo, before he was cursed by Vaati. He is a famous Minish sage. Even among Minish inventors, he was renowned for his amazing creations.

figurines.name: Black Knight
figurines.description: Appears in Dark Hyrule Castle. This is the strongest Dark Nut, with a good balance of attack and defense. They will do anything to stop you.

figurines.name: Vaati Reborn
figurines.description: The sorcerer Vaati took this form after draining the power of the light force from Princess Zelda. The evil beams from his eyes are devastating.

figurines.name: Vaati Transfigured
figurines.description: Once Vaati's body has been shattered, this dark form rises up, all that remains of the evil sorcerer. Only the sacred Four Sword can defeat him.

figurines.name: Vaati's Wrath
figurines.description: This is the embodiment of purest evil, the final form of the power-mad Vaati. Its mind is consumed with a hunger for destruction. Find its weakness.
